title: Allegiant Completes Acquisition of Sun Country Airlines, Creating the Leading Leisure-Focused U.S. Airline
summary: Allegiant Travel Company ( NASDAQ: ALGT ) today announced it has successfully completed its acquisition of Sun Country Airlines Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: SNCY), bringing together two complementary carriers focused on affordable leisure travel. The transaction closed following satisfaction of customary closing conditions, including receipt of required regulatory approvals and approval by the shareholders of each of Allegiant and Sun Country. The combination strengthens Allegiant's position as a leading U.S. leisure airline by expanding its network, increasing scale, and enhancing its diversified operating model. "Today marks a defining moment in Allegiant's history as we officially join forces with Sun Country to create the leading leisure-focused airline in the United States," said Allegiant CEO Gregory C.
